items.title: George Guesnon Interview, 1965-09
items.q: I get a good strong trumpet player. like Andrew Anderson... We got a nice old band.

ctx.x: And Johnny should play more clarinet than alto.

And all that. I mean, all that old kind of shit. It ain't giving you nothing. It won't find all that fault. But every time we go there, we set the raptors on fire. But I mean, yeah. Me, Johnny, they go out on drums. And Joe Jackson on piano. And I get a good strong trumpet player. like Andrew Anderson, or somebody like that, or even the deep. Had the deep played with us. We got a nice old band. I don't know what it was, you see, they run everything and they run the way you want. You can't come in there if you're…
And all that kind of shit.
